name: 06-stat-replication
sql: select pid, usesysid::regrole::text as usename, application_name, client_addr::text as client_addr, state, sent_lsn::text as sent_lsn, write_lsn::text as write_lsn, flush_lsn::text as flush_lsn, replay_lsn::text as replay_lsn, pg_wal_lsn_diff(pg_current_wal_lsn(), sent_lsn) as lag_bytes_sent, write_lag, flush_lag, replay_lag, sync_priority, sync_state from pg_stat_replication
